question: List the top 5 branches by commission revenue over 10 million in 2013
expected_sql: SELECT dim_broker.Branch AS Branch, SUM(fact_trades.Commission) AS commission_revenue FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades AS fact_trades INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date AS dim_date ON fact_trades.SK_CreateDateID = dim_date.SK_DateID INNER JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker AS dim_broker ON fact_trades.SK_BrokerID = dim_broker.SK_BrokerID WHERE dim_date.CalendarYearID = 2013 GROUP BY dim_broker.Branch HAVING SUM(fact_trades.Commission) > 10000000 ORDER BY commission_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: Carrier of the metric threshold (HAVING semantics)
